_meta.purpose: Binding media manifest for /invest. Every visual slot on the site is defined here. Grok renders these assets in these slots — no substitutions, no generated imagery, no reuse of one asset across multiple slots unless listed. Paths are repo-relative to handoff/invest-microsite/.
_meta.provenance: All deck/* images extracted 1:1 from the Series B Presentation Cut (slides 1–36). posters/* are official YouTube thumbnails. hero-loop.mp4 and closing-loop.mp4 are the Cut's own animated cover plates converted to 720p mp4 loops (14.6 s).
_meta.resolution_note: Deck plates are 960×540-class. Render at max 1200 px wide; never upscale beyond container. Hi-res originals may be swapped in later at identical paths.

hero.behavior: autoplay muted loop playsinline; single full-bleed layer; dark gradient scrim from bottom (rgba(0,0,0,.75) → transparent at 55% height); headline + sub + one CTA bottom-left on the scrim; NOTHING else composited. No second image. No text from any other layer may intersect the hero.
hero.alt: Navier N30 foiling across San Francisco Bay, city skyline behind

chapter_dividers._rule: Each chapter opens with a full-bleed solo image plate (100vw, 55–70vh, object-fit cover), optional one-line caption chip BELOW the plate on the dark field. Text never on the plate.

close.behavior: same treatment as hero; closing line on scrim

slots.note: The wireframe appears HERE ONLY — nowhere else on the site.

slots.caption: Shipbuilding at scale is not new — it is remembered.
Air freight moves 35% of trade value in under 1% of its tonnage. The gap in between is the market.

slots.note: Ship as plate v1; rebuild native (same data, conservative case) allowed later.
